title: RosePO: Aligning LLM-based Recommenders with Human Values
reasoning: The paper focuses on aligning Large Language Model-based recommenders with 'Human Values', specifically the 'Helpful and Harmless' (HH) framework. It evaluates the alignment process by measuring its success in mitigating biases (semantic hallucination and popularity bias), which are treated as proxies for the ethical harmlessness of the system.
